title: Arcane Archives
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished key-art image for "Arcane Archives", wide 2:1 landscape, opaque.
Scene/backdrop: a magnificent enchanted midnight library, towering shadowy bookshelves, distant tall arched windows with moonlit violet glass, subtle warm candlelight. Existing identity: deep purple and midnight blue, antique gold, restrained mint aether glow.
Subject: a wise cream-and-brown archivist owl with bright amber eyes and a dark blue-violet star-dotted cape, perched on two aged books beside a closed navy grimoire with ornate gold corners, a gold crescent clasp, purple jewel and violet bookmark ribbon. Professionally painted tangible feather, leather and gilded details. Gentle arcane motes, no excessive particles.
Composition/framing: WIDE 2:1 catalogue card. Large two-line title in quiet dark space balanced with a compact owl-and-grimoire vignette. IMPORTANT: keep ALL title letters and ALL of the owl/book focal group in central 76% width and 64% height (x12–88%, y18–82%). Generous empty margins, no cut-off owl wings or title. Background shelves may extend to edges.
Style/medium: sophisticated original fantasy game key art, lush painterly illustration, carefully modeled depth, restrained cinematic lighting, cohesive premium casino collection.
Text (verbatim): "Arcane Archives". Exactly these two words once, on two lines, large highly legible cream-gold fantasy serif lettering with refined dimensional edges. Title must be crisp and readable at 256x128.
Constraints: no other writing, no slogans or payout promises, no reels, no buttons, no fake interface, no logo/watermark, no additional characters, no unrelated cultural or religious motifs, no pile of money. One image for this game only.
editPrompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, Arcane Archives title card.
Change ONLY the size and position of the owl-and-books focal group on the right. Scale the entire owl, cape, two stacked books and upright grimoire together to 75% of their current size, with the group centered vertically and its base resting slightly farther back on the library floor. The full owl tuft must begin below 18% of image height, and the full bottom book/ribbon must end above 82% of image height. The complete group must fit inside x55–87% of image width. Repaint exposed areas as matching background library/floor. Preserve exact title "Arcane Archives", lettering size and position, background architecture, palette, lighting and wide 2:1 opaque canvas. No new subjects or text.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected generated final master and 768x384 WebP. Exact title, ornate violet library, caped amber-eyed archivist owl and crescent grimoire preserve existing identity. No extra slogans, interface or unrelated motifs.
visualCheck.thumbnail256x128: Inspected at 256x128. Both words legible and owl/book silhouette distinct.
visualCheck.crop: Title and complete owl/book group sit within central 80% width / 70% height after targeted group-size edit.
visualCheck.compression: 82,960 bytes; WebP quality 84; below ideal 120 KB.
